subject: general
question:
The pie chart shows the percentages of different kinds of expenditure while making a mobile phone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517f240dfb05928cf246449ea722d446384c27aa30f03982ba89c7cfad765fb8.png] 

If the total cost of making 250 mobile phones is 25 lakh, then what is the cost of transportation on a single phone?
solution:
**Given:**

Total cost for 250 phones = ₹25 lakh

Transportation cost percentage = 10%

**Calculation:**

The cost of a single phone = ₹25 lakh / 250 = ₹10,000

The transportation cost (10% of ₹10,000) = ₹10,000 × 10% = ₹1,000

**∴ The transportation cost on a single phone is ₹1,000.**
